item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Authorities continued forcibly disappearing opponents, subjecting detainees to torture and forced confessions, and failed to investigate widespread torture and mistreatment; alleged police perpetrators in a mass-trial case faced no serious investigation.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Events reported for 2022, providing limited contextual evidence for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the conduct to Egyptian Interior Ministry police, National Security agents, prosecutors, and authorities under President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi's government; it does not establish Sisi's personal direction of each incident.","limitations":["Human Rights Watch is a secondary institutional source.","The cited evidence predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Authorities failed to conduct an independent, effective, and transparent investigation into economist Ayman Hadhoud's suspicious death in custody after his reported disappearance, despite evidence of possible disappearance, torture, ill-treatment, and denial of timely health care.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.9","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 event; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the detention and investigative failure to Egyptian authorities; it does not document Sisi's personal involvement.","limitations":["The account relies on Human Rights Watch's assessment of reported evidence.","The event occurred before the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Videos authenticated by Human Rights Watch showed three extrajudicial executions of shackled or wounded men in custody in North Sinai; members of army-affiliated militias and the army were indicated as responsible.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.5","2B.9","3B.1","3B.2","3B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 event; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report links the perpetrators to army-affiliated militias trained and supported by the army; it does not establish Sisi's direct order or knowledge.","limitations":["The source reports an analysis of circulated videos rather than a judicial finding.","The event predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The army demolished more than 12,300 buildings in North Sinai from 2013 through July 2020 without upholding human-rights obligations on forced evictions; many demolitions allegedly lacked evidence of absolute military necessity and hundreds of families remained uncompensated.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.7","3B.9","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Historical finding through 2020, relevant only as background to 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the campaign to the Egyptian army during Sisi's presidency; it does not specify his personal authorization for individual demolitions.","limitations":["The reported period ends before the target year.","The characterization of possible war crimes is attributed to Human Rights Watch's assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Prison authorities refused dissident Salah Soltan's requests for an independent doctor, medication, and medical equipment, and he reported continued solitary confinement, constant lighting, and in-cell CCTV surveillance after transfer to Badr Complex.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","6B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 detention conditions; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the practices to Egyptian prison authorities and describes alleged retaliation connected to his son's advocacy; it does not establish Sisi's personal direction.","limitations":["Conditions are reported through family accounts and Human Rights Watch.","The evidence predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Egyptian security forces and prison staff were reported to use systematic sexual violence, including rape, genital electrocution, threats, and abusive cavity searches, to degrade and coerce detainees.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Report released in 2022 concerning practices reported during that period; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns security forces and prison staff under the Egyptian state; it does not establish Sisi's personal knowledge or orders.","limitations":["The finding is attributed to a joint report by Egyptian Front for Human Rights and Freedom Initiative.","The cited material does not describe state corrective action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The president confirmed sentences against Alaa Abd al-Fattah, Mohamed al-Baqer, and Mohamed Ibrahim issued by extraordinary Emergency State Security Courts, whose decisions were not subject to appeal.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","4B.4","4B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 judicial action; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report expressly attributes confirmation of the sentences to the president, Abdel Fattah al-Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not provide the complete case records.","The action occurred before the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Judges and prosecutors routinely remanded thousands of detainees without presenting evidence, and prosecutors allegedly moved detainees into new cases after release orders to circumvent the legal two-year pretrial-detention limit.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","4B.4","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 practice; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the practice to Egyptian judges and prosecutors; it does not establish Sisi's personal involvement.","limitations":["The source describes a reported systemic practice rather than individual rulings.","The evidence predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"A national dialogue announced by President al-Sisi produced no concrete policies to improve Egypt's human-rights situation at the time of the report.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.6","4B.10","8B.1","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Announced in 2022 and assessed during 2022; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report directly attributes the announcement to President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi and the lack of concrete policy output to the dialogue process.","limitations":["The report gives no later outcome for the dialogue.","The assessment is time-bounded to the report's publication."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Authorities used arbitrary, virtually indefinite travel bans and asset freezes against civil-society members, with no clear formal notice or effective court challenge; the measures harmed family life, careers, and mental health.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9","6B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 practice; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the measures to Egyptian authorities under Sisi's government; it does not identify Sisi's personal role in individual bans.","limitations":["The source does not provide a complete count of affected persons.","The evidence predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"ANHRI ended operations after threats, violent attacks, and arrests by the National Security Agency, alongside pressure to register under a restrictive associations law.","question_ids":["3B.8","4B.3","4B.5","4B.10","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 event; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the threats, attacks, and arrests to the National Security Agency and the registration pressure to Egyptian authorities; it does not establish Sisi's personal direction.","limitations":["The report does not identify individual perpetrators or orders.","The organization closed before the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Authorities arrested two media figures after apparent criticism of the National Broadcasting Authority, prosecuted Mada Masr journalists over reporting on the pro-government Nation's Future Party, and blocked hundreds of news and human-rights websites without judicial orders.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 actions; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the arrests, prosecutions, and website blocking to Egyptian authorities; it does not establish Sisi's personal involvement in each action.","limitations":["The source uses 'apparently' for the motive behind the media arrests.","The evidence predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Egyptian authorities detained Sudanese refugees and asylum seekers, with some subjected to forced labor and beatings, and kept detainees in overcrowded rooms without adequate food or medical care.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Late 2021 and early 2022 incidents; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the detention and treatment to Egyptian police and authorities; it does not establish Sisi's personal direction.","limitations":["The source reports at least 30 detainees, not a comprehensive total.","The incidents predate the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Authorities deported 31 Eritreans, including eight children, after detention in poor conditions and denial of access to UNHCR to lodge asylum claims; the report characterized the deportations as violating the prohibition on refoulement.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.7","6B.6","6B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 event; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the deportations and denial of UNHCR access to Egyptian authorities; it does not establish Sisi's personal authorization.","limitations":["The legal characterization is attributed to the Refugees Platform in Egypt and Human Rights Watch's reporting.","The event predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The government failed for years to enact laws and policies seriously addressing violence against women; authorities also failed to protect refugee and asylum-seeking women from assault and rape, while police reportedly refused to register complaints or investigate.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","3B.9","4B.7","6B.3","6B.8","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"General finding reported for 2022 and preceding years; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the policy and enforcement failures to the Egyptian government and police; it does not establish Sisi's personal conduct.","limitations":["The finding is broad and does not quantify unmet protection or case outcomes.","The cited evidence predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Security forces used digital targeting against LGBT people, including entrapment, online harassment, outing, extortion, monitoring, arbitrary arrest and detention, and prosecutions based on digital evidence; detainees were reportedly ill-treated in custody.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.3","3B.5","3B.7","3B.8","4B.9","6B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2022 and earlier documented practices; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the conduct to Egyptian security forces and reliance on cybercrime and morality provisions; it does not establish Sisi's personal direction.","limitations":["The source reports documented cases but not their total number.","The evidence predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Nearly one-third of Egypt's population lived below the national poverty line, while disruptions from Russia's invasion of Ukraine increased prices of wheat and sunflower oil and limited food access for poor and vulnerable populations.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Economic conditions and effects reported for 2022; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes national economic conditions and government subsidy decisions but does not attribute the war-induced disruption to Sisi.","limitations":["The poverty statistic's reference year is not specified in the excerpt.","The external shock materially constrains attribution to the ruler."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Egypt requested IMF support in March and agreed in October to a six-month, US$3 billion program; rights groups raised concerns about insufficient emphasis on expanded social protection, judicial independence, corruption, and transparency.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.9","6B.1","6B.5","6B.6","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2022 policy response; limited fit for 2023-2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the IMF request and negotiated program to Egyptian authorities under Sisi's government; concerns are attributed to rights groups.","limitations":["The excerpt does not report implementation or outcomes of the program.","The program began before the target period but may have carried forward."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c6c3b2e5b5773e2","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"The EU planned to allocate €80 million in 2022-2023 for equipment and services supporting Egyptian border management, including surveillance, despite Egypt's human-rights record; the European Parliament later called for a profound and comprehensive review of EU relations with Egypt.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.9","3B.5","3B.7","4B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The funding plan directly spans 2023, while the parliamentary review occurred in 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the border-management policy to the EU and Egyptian authorities jointly; it does not establish Sisi's personal direction of EU decisions.","limitations":["This is primarily an external-actor finding about support to Egypt.","The excerpt does not establish how the funds were executed in 2023."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is titled World Report 2023 but its substantive country material concerns events of 2022 and earlier; direct period fit for 2023-2023 is therefore limited.","The source is a human-rights report and does not provide material evidence on nuclear risk or most economic-administration, integrity, and effectiveness lenses beyond the specifically mapped facts.","No fact was treated as proof of Sisi's personal intent or knowledge unless the source expressly attributed the action to the president."]}
